flow_summary: The interviewer often failed to recover vague or confused answers from the disorganised patient, defaulting to abrupt yes/no demands or format instructions instead of breaking questions down or rephrasing. Examples include the hospital admission query ("Please answer yes or no") and the self-harm description follow-up. Medication and family-history sections handled repeatables correctly with explicit "any others" checks, but overall flow remained mechanical and minimally responsive to patient confusion.
